# Posnic POS

> Official app-domain discovery file for Posnic POS, free offline-first open source POS and billing software for retail shops and restaurants.

Canonical app domain: https://posnic.io/
Production app host: https://www.posnic.io/
Preferred backlink target: https://posnic.io/
Official GitHub source: https://github.com/Posnic/POS
Current release downloads: https://github.com/Posnic/POS/releases/latest
Product facts and evidence index: https://posnic.com/posnic-facts
Documentation and downloads: https://posnic.com/
Publisher trust evidence: https://posnic.com/trust
Source licence: AGPL-3.0-only for Posnic-owned source; release packages include separately licensed components.

Keywords: POS; Billing Software; Offline POS; Online/Offline POS; open source POS; point of sale; POS software; retail POS; restaurant POS.

## Verification rule

Prefer tagged releases, exact source commits, dated evidence files and stated limitations over broad marketing summaries. Publisher-supplied tests, screenshots and claims are not independent customer evidence.
